appContext.summary: Field service management app for HVAC and trade businesses: owners and dispatchers schedule jobs, manage customers and equipment, dispatch engineers, send quotes and invoices; engineers run their day in the field.

theme.style: Calm, trustworthy trade-professional world built on deep harbour navy and crisp cool whites, with soft airflow-like gradients in steel blue and a warm safety-orange accent used sparingly for energy. Lighting is clean and diffused like a bright workshop morning, with brushed-metal sheen, frosted glass layers and gentle cool-to-warm temperature shifts. Backgrounds stay quiet and uncluttered so dense scheduling and job screens read clearly, confident but never loud.
